```python
def summary(run):
    """Completion, the mean trip and the shares of people by mode."""
    modes = run.trip_modes().to_pandas()
    people = modes.groupby("mode")["weight"].sum() / modes["weight"].sum() * 100
    return {
        "completed (%)": round(100 * run.completion["completed"] / run.completion["total_trips"], 1),
        "mean trip (min)": round(run.mean_travel_time_s / 60, 2),
        "car (%)": round(people["car"], 2),
        "bike (%)": round(people["bike"], 2),
        "transit (%)": round(people["transit"], 2),
    }


pd.DataFrame({"base": summary(before), "street closed": summary(closed), "cycle track": summary(tracked)}).T
```
